description: 2004 Ford Mustang SVT Cobra Convertible | Mystichrome EditionOnly 2,537 Original Miles Collector Grade "Terminator"The Legend of the "Terminator"Produced by Ford's Special Vehicle Team (SVT), the 20032004 Cobras earned the nickname "Terminator" for their absolute dominance over the competition. At its heart lies a hand-built 4.6L DOHC V8 equipped with a factory Eaton M112 Supercharger. While officially rated at 390 HP, these engines were famously underrated, often producing well over 420 HP in stock form.The Mystichrome Appearance Package (Order Code 68M)To celebrate the Mustangs 40th Anniversary, SVT introduced the Mystichrome package. This was not just a paint job, it was a technological marvel.The Paint: Utilizing ChromaFlair light-interference pigments, the finish shifts through a mesmerizing spectrum of teal, blue, royal purple, and deep black depending on the lighting and viewing angle.The Leather: In a world-first for production cars, the interior leather seat inserts and steering wheel grips feature the same color-shifting technology, mirroring the exteriors prismatic effect.Extreme Rarity & Production NumbersThe Mystichrome was a strictly limited-run edition, making it one of the most sought-after late-model Mustangs in existence.Total Mystichrome Production: Only 1,010 units total (Coupe and Convertible combined).The Convertible Factor: Only 495 Mystichrome Convertibles were ever produced, making this body style significantly rarer than the coupe.Low-Mile Survivor: With just 2,537 miles, this vehicle is in the top tier of all remaining examples, preserved in "time capsule" condition.Vehicle HighlightsSupercharged 4.6L V8: Hand-assembled with forged internals for legendary durability.Tremec T-56 6-Speed Manual: The only transmission offered, providing a pure, connected driving experience.Independent Rear Suspension (IRS): A signature Cobra feature for superior handling compared to standard Mustangs.Exclusive Trim: 17-inch factory chrome five-spoke wheels and unique SVT badging.Premium Features: Includes the Mach 460 Audio System with a 6-disc CD changer and a power-retractable top.Historical SignificanceThe 2004 model year marked the final year of the "New Edge" SN-95 platform and the last SVT Cobra until the nameplate was replaced by the Shelby GT500 in 2007. Because of its over-engineered engine and one-year-only paint technology, the Mystichrome Terminator has become a staple of elite car collections worldwide.Collector Note: Finding a Mystichrome with under 3,000 miles is an increasingly rare opportunity. As a 40th Anniversary celebration piece, its place in Ford history is permanently cemented.

description:
Theres a particular kind of theater to the 2020 MercedesBenz SLClass SL 550 a roadgoing sonnet that writes itself in curves and chrome. It arrives like a guest who knows exactly when to smile: low, wide and impeccably poiseful, every surface sculpted to catch light and attention. The long hood and short cockpit are classic gestures reimagined with modern finesse, from some angles it reads like a sculpture midstride, all tension and promise, and from others like an old friend whos learned new tricks.

Slide into the cabin and the mood becomes almost conspiratorial. The SLs interior is warm leather and purposeful hush, a place where morning coffee and latenight playlists both feel exalted. Seats cradle you as if suggesting that journeys, even short ones, deserve ceremony. Soft metals, fine stitching and controls that click with satisfying insistence make ordinary interactions feel deliberate, this is a car that rewards presence, not distraction. With the top down the cockpit turns into a private theater where the world is slightly louder and infinitely more interesting.

On the road the SL 550 trades coyness for charm. Its not a shout, its a practiced wink. Throttle responses are immediate, steering is poised, and the chassis seems quietly delighted to oblige a more spirited pace.   • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.

The 2024 Subaru Outback Wilderness in Crystal White Pearl is a rugged and capable SUV that also offers a clean and refined appearance. Its Crystal White Pearl paint gives the vehicle a bright white color with a soft, pearly shine that reflects light nicely, making it look both modern and upscale. This elegant color contrasts perfectly with the Wilderness trims darker, rugged design elements, creating a unique balance between toughness and style.

On the outside, the Outback Wilderness stands out with its bold and adventurous design. The front end features a strong grille, durable bumpers, and sharp LED headlights that give it a confident and ready-for-anything look. The Wilderness trim includes black cladding around the body, reinforced roof rails, and subtle copper-colored accents that highlight its off-road personality. The raised ground clearance and wider stance make the vehicle look more aggressive while also improving its ability to handle rough terrain.

Inside, the cabin is designed for both comfort and durability. The seats are supportive and made with materials that can handle active lifestyles, making them ideal for outdoor trips or everyday use. The interior layout is simple and easy to use, with a large touchscreen display in the center of the dashboard for controlling music, navigation, and connectivity features. There is plenty of room for passengers in both rows, and the rear seats can fold down to create a large cargo area for carrying gear, luggage, or groceries.

Under the hood, the Outback Wilderness is powered by a turbocharged engine that delivers strong and reliable performance. It provides plenty of power for highway driving, while also offering the torque needed for off-road situations. The standard all-wheel-drive system gives the vehicle excellent traction in different conditions, including rain, dirt, and uneven surfaces. This makes it a great choice for drivers who enjoy exploring beyond paved roads.

When driving, the Outback Wilderness feels stable and comfortable. The suspension is built to handle rough terrain, but it also provides a smooth ride on regular roads. It absorbs bumps well and keeps the vehicle balanced, even on uneven surfaces. The steering is responsive, and the elevated driving position gives the driver a clear view of the road ahead.

Technology in the vehicle is modern and practical. The infotainment system is easy to use and includes smartphone connectivity, allowing drivers to access apps, music, and navigation easily. There are also many safety features included, such as lane assistance, adaptive cruise control, and collision warning systems, which help make driving safer and more convenient.

Overall, the Crystal White Pearl 2024 Subaru Outback Wilderness is a well-rounded SUV that combines rugged capability with everyday comfort. Its bright and stylish exterior color enhances its bold design, while its strong performance, spacious interior, and advanced features make it a great option for both daily driving and outdoor adventures.

    • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
    • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
    • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
    • Rear camera with washer - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. description:
A one-owner 2022 Subaru Outback Wilderness with clean CARFAX and just under 62,000 miles- the kind of used Subaru that was built for exactly the roads and winters we have here in Northeast Ohio, and it shows in how this one was kept.

One Ohio owner from new, purchased in August 2021 and maintained with consistent regularity throughout. No accidents or damage reported to CARFAX no structural damage, no airbag deployment, no title issues of any kind. The service history is detailed and documented: oil and filter changes performed at regular intervals, tires rotated consistently, brakes checked multiple times across the ownership period, and a software update completed at the dealer in late 2023. The most recent oil change and tire rotation were completed in February 2026 at 57,803 miles. A windshield repair was completed in March 2026 through a local auto glass shop prior to the vehicle coming to our lot. No confirmed remaining factory warranty the original basic and powertrain coverage has expired per CARFAX.

One Ohio owner, no accidents, and a service record that reads like someone who actually paid attention to the maintenance schedule that's a strong foundation for a used Outback at this mileage, particularly in a trim built for conditions more demanding than your average commute.

The Outback Wilderness was engineered for the people who don't turn around when the road gets rough. At the center of it is Subaru's Symmetrical All-Wheel Drive paired with Dual X-MODE, which gives the driver two distinct traction settings Snow/Dirt for the lake-effect days that define an Ohio winter, and Deep Snow/Mud for anything beyond that. Ground clearance sits at 9.5 inches, notably higher than a standard Outback, and the suspension is off-road tuned. The 2.4-liter turbocharged boxer engine adds a meaningful step up in power over the base Outback, and the Lineartronic CVT with 8-speed manual mode keeps that power accessible when you actually need it.

EyeSight Driver Assist Technology is standard on this trim, and this Outback Wilderness is equipped with the full suite: automatic emergency braking, advanced adaptive cruise control with lane centering, lane departure and sway warning, and blind spot detection with rear cross-traffic alert. The 180-degree front view monitor adds an extra layer of situational awareness whether you're navigating a tight trail approach or a crowded parking lot. A rear vision camera with guidelines is also included.

The STARLINK 11.6" multimedia system on this unit includes the optional navigation package a large, multi-touch display with over-the-air map updates, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, and SiriusXM. Wireless charging is included via the Outback Wilderness Package. Dual-zone automatic climate control keeps front and rear passengers comfortable regardless of what the weather is doing outside, and heated front and rear seats along with a wiper de-icer make the cold season genuinely manageable rather than just tolerable. The 10-way power driver's seat includes lumbar support. A power moonroof with slide and tilt came as part of Option Package 22. The standard StarTex water-repellent seat material is a practical touch on a vehicle that's likely seen some trail use it holds up, and it cleans easily.
The ladder-type roof rails carry a 700-lb static load capacity, which is substantial and purpose-built for gear. Splash guards, cargo sidewall protectors, and a rear seat back protector round out the practicality features included in the Wilderness Package. LED headlights with high beam assist and LED fog lights handle visibility on back roads after dark. Crystal White Pearl exterior.

22 city/26 highway MPG.
